parsed.root_cause: A Chaos Mesh memory stress experiment targeting the valkey-cart pod caused the container to crash loop, leading to service degradation and high latency across the application.
evidence: Pod otel-demo/valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft is in CrashLoopBackOff state with KubePodCrashLooping alert firing.
Kubernetes events show a Chaos Mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-valkey-memory-stress' attempting to apply a StressChaos experiment on the valkey-cart pod.
Events indicate the chaos experiment failed or was forbidden because the target task was not found or the pod was already in a bad state, correlating with the crash loop.
High CPU throttling (67.51%) is observed on the cart service container, consistent with resource exhaustion from a memory stress attack.
Multiple services (frontend, frontend-proxy, checkout) are experiencing high latency (>15s) and request errors, indicating a downstream failure originating from the database dependency.
